limits: The audit covers the present v0.4 manuscript and no future revision.
Abstract-level review supports only claims within the source abstract.
The formal search leaves author confirmation, inaccessible-record review, authenticated databases, and disciplinary interfaces open.
The audit supplies no originality, systematic-review, reliability, or validity finding.
